note.text: biuro is a neuter noun. The ending changes with the case the sentence asks for. Learn the trigger with each form.

why.text: The dictionary form. Use it for the subject: co? (what?)
The final -o becomes -a. Use after do, z meaning from, bez, dla and after nie ma.
A neuter noun takes -u in the dative, not -owi. Use with pomagać and dziękować.
For a neuter noun the accusative is the same as the nominative. Use after mam, widzę, kupuję.
The ending is -em. Use with zarządzać, kierować and interesować się.
After w, o and przy the ending is -e, and r softens to rz.
The neuter vocative equals the nominative. You will rarely address an office.
The neuter plural nominative ends in -a.
The genitive plural has no ending here: biur. Use it with numbers five and above.
The neuter accusative plural equals the nominative plural.
The neuter vocative plural equals the nominative plural.

The meaning “office” is expressed by biuro.
The meaning “in the office” is expressed by biurze.
The meaning “of the office” is expressed by biura.
The meaning “to the office” is expressed by biuru.
The meaning “with the office” is expressed by biurem.
The meaning “offices” is expressed by biura.
The meaning “of the offices” is expressed by biur.
The meaning “in the offices” is expressed by biurach.
The correct line is “biuro”.
The correct line is “W biurze.”.
The correct line is “Mam biuro.”.
The correct line is “W biurze.”.
The correct line is “Pięć biur.”.
The base forms and their meanings are paired on the board.
Place forms answer where, and each has one exact English meaning.

biuro here is nominative singular.
genitive singular of biuro is biura. of, after do.
biura here is genitive singular.
dative singular of biuro is biuru. to, after pomagać.
biuru here is dative singular.
accusative singular of biuro is biuro. object.
biuro here is accusative singular.

biurze here is locative singular.

biura here is nominative plural.

The locative singular form is biurze.
The genitive singular form is biura.
The dative singular form is biuru.
The instrumental singular form is biurem.
The genitive plural form is biur.
The locative plural form is biurach.
The dative plural form is biurom.
The instrumental plural form is biurami.
The nominative plural form is biura.
The vocative singular form is biuro.
Idę do biura. do means to; it takes the genitive.
Wracam z biura. z meaning from takes the genitive.
Nie ma biura dziś. Negation turns the object into the genitive.
Szukam biura. szukać takes the genitive.
Bez biura nie pracuję. bez means without and takes the genitive.
To jest dla biura. dla means for and takes the genitive.
Pomagam biuru. pomagać takes the dative.
Dziękuję biuru. dziękować takes the dative.
Daję biuru komputer. dawać gives to someone in the dative.
Ufam biuru. ufać takes the dative.
Which case follows do? Answer: biura.
Which case follows w when you are inside a place? Answer: biurze.
Which case follows pomagać? Answer: biuru.
Which case follows zarządzać? Answer: biurem.
Which case follows z when it means with? Answer: biurem.
Which case follows o when it means about? Answer: biurze.
Which case follows five or more? Answer: biur.
Which case follows przy? Answer: biurze.
Which case follows przeciwko? Answer: biuru.
Which case follows interesować się? Answer: biurem.
Pracuję w biurze. means I work in the office.
Jestem w biurze. means I am in the office.
Idę do biura. means I am going to the office.
Wracam z biura. means I am coming back from the office.
Nie ma biura dziś. means There is no office today.
Szukam biura. means I am looking for the office.
Pomagam biuru. means I help the office.
Dziękuję biuru. means I thank the office.
Daję biuru komputer. means I give the office a computer.
Ufam biuru. means I trust the office.
Zarządzam biurem. means I manage the office.
Kieruję biurem. means I run the office.
Interesuję się biurem. means I am interested in the office.
Mówimy o biurze. means We are talking about the office.
Czekam przy biurze. means I am waiting by the office.
Mam biuro. means I have an office.
Widzę biuro. means I see the office.
Kupuję biuro. means I am buying an office.
Pracujemy w biurach. means We work in offices.
Zarządzamy biurami. means We manage offices.
